quote: In 1849, de Polignac made the more general conjecture that for every natural number k, there are infinitely many primes p such that p + 2k is also prime. The case k = 1 of de Polignac's conjecture is the twin prime conjecture.
note: The twin prime conjecture is the special case (k=1) of de Polignac's 1849 conjecture about prime pairs. It is a sub-case of Landau's problems, but dates to 1849 with de Polignac, earlier than Landau's 1912 formulation.
